said:
The capacities as built are Kirov 4000, Omsk 2500 and Tara 3000. The Omsk annex (handed over March) is additional real space, so Omsk’s usable capacity is 3700. Monday stocks therefore leave remaining room of 900 (Kirov), 1800 (Omsk) and 1000 (Tara). Dividing by the recorded net weekly intakes of 300, 250 and 260 respectively yields 3 weeks, 7.2 weeks and ~3.85 weeks. Kirov therefore fills first.

ANSWER: kirov
